rooms.title: Water Gallery
rooms.purpose: Introduce the modeled water domain, units, boundaries, and limitations.
rooms.visitorAction: Inspect a basin definition and select the model whose scope matches the question.
rooms.authoritativeState: Versioned basin inputs, boundary conditions, model identity, and declared units.
rooms.evidenceRule: A water-level field is not a complete three-dimensional fluid state.

rooms.title: Wave Basin
rooms.purpose: Explore wave evolution with an explicitly selected reference model.
rooms.visitorAction: Change supported initial wave conditions and compare model output.
rooms.authoritativeState: Initial conditions, boundary conditions, time settings, and wave-model output.
rooms.evidenceRule: Label the 1D wave reference separately from 2D shallow-water behavior.

rooms.title: Bathymetry & Terrain
rooms.purpose: Inspect how a configured depth field shapes a basin model.
rooms.visitorAction: Change the basin depth map and compare supported water-state outputs.
rooms.authoritativeState: Versioned basin geometry, bathymetry, initial water state, and model output.
rooms.evidenceRule: Terrain affects water only when the selected model consumes the terrain data.

rooms.title: Rainfall & Runoff
rooms.purpose: Study declared rainfall inputs and their supported contribution to basin state.
rooms.visitorAction: Vary a rainfall-rate field and inspect the resulting evidence.
rooms.authoritativeState: Rainfall-rate input and basin state, with explicit model and boundary assumptions.
rooms.evidenceRule: A rainfall field alone does not model infiltration, drainage, or a complete watershed.

rooms.title: Vessel Test Tank
rooms.purpose: Prepare experiments for vessel and floating-body interaction with water.
rooms.visitorAction: Configure a vessel preview and inspect which force models are available.
rooms.authoritativeState: Authored vessel geometry and, only when integrated, coupled body and fluid state.
rooms.evidenceRule: Do not claim buoyancy, drag, or simulated vessel motion until a validated coupling model supplies it.

rooms.title: Shoreline & Structures
rooms.purpose: Explore boundary geometry and future water-to-structure interactions.
rooms.visitorAction: Compare an authored shoreline or barrier and inspect supported boundary behavior.
rooms.authoritativeState: Boundary geometry and any explicitly selected, implemented interaction model.
rooms.evidenceRule: Do not invent structural loads, erosion, or damage from visual contact alone.

rooms.title: Evidence & Timeline
rooms.purpose: Make basin inputs, model identity, outputs, and revisions inspectable.
rooms.visitorAction: Compare experiment revisions and replay or export a recorded run when supported.
rooms.authoritativeState: Experiment revision, inputs, model/version, outputs, units, and diagnostics.
rooms.evidenceRule: Label results by maturity and preserve provenance; a fixture is not a live run.
